product.olivetti-philos-46-color-plus.su: The Philos 46 Color Plus combined a numeric keypad and external audio connections.
product.olivetti-philos-46-color-plus.hi: Folha de S.Paulo tested the Philos 46 Color Plus in November 1994 and reported a price of US$6,592 for its test configuration.
product.olivetti-philos-46-color-plus.ar: Audio supported multimedia applications. The test machine had a built-in microphone and speaker, external audio jacks and Type III PCMCIA.
